updates.title: Updates
updates.folder.help: Reticulum address of the signed update folder for this channel (npub… or hex folder id). Only the folder owner can publish binaries; every download is verified by sha256. Leave blank to reset to the built-in default.
updates.fdroid_only.title: Updates only from F-Droid
updates.fdroid_only.desc: XPRS never downloads itself. When F-Droid has a newer version, it opens F-Droid to install it.
updates.beta.title: Include beta releases
updates.beta.desc: Get pre-release builds earlier (may be unstable).
updates.fdroid.unreachable: F-Droid could not be reached, or does not list XPRS yet.
updates.web_notice: In-app updates are available on the Android, Linux and Windows builds. On the web, reload to get the latest version.
